name: ollama
//: The same upstream as ollama.json, pointed at an Ollama already running on the host instead of at the compose service. Use this on macOS: Docker Desktop has no GPU passthrough, so the containerized model runs on CPU, while a host Ollama uses Metal. It also skips a 7 GB image pull. Start the host server with OLLAMA_HOST=0.0.0.0 ollama serve, then run the normal `make up` -- no profile needed, because the model server is not a compose service in this arrangement.
